entries.title: Jeremiah 33:1
segments: ¶Moreover the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah a second time, while he was still shut up in the court of the prison, saying,

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:2
segments: "Thus says the LORD who made it, the LORD who formed it to establish it (the LORD [is] His name):

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:3
segments: 'Call to Me, and I will answer you, and show you great and mighty things, which you do not know.'

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:4
segments: "For thus says the LORD, the God of Israel, concerning the houses of this city and the houses of the kings of Judah, which have been pulled down [to fortify] against the siege mounds and the sword:

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:5
segments: 'They come to fight with the Chaldeans, but [only] to fill their places with the dead bodies of men whom I will slay in My anger and My fury, all for whose wickedness I have hidden My face from this city.

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:6
segments: 'Behold, I will bring it health and healing; I will heal them and reveal to them the abundance of peace and truth.

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:7
segments: 'And I will cause the captives of Judah and the captives of Israel to return, and will rebuild those places as at the first.

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:8
segments: 'I will cleanse them from all their iniquity by which they have sinned against Me, and I will pardon all their iniquities by which they have sinned and by which they have transgressed against Me.

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:9
segments: 'Then it shall be to Me a name of joy, a praise, and an honor before all nations of the earth, who shall hear all the good that I do to them; they shall fear and tremble for all the goodness and all the prosperity that I provide for it.'

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:10
segments: ¶"Thus says the LORD: 'Again there shall be heard in this place-of which you say, "It [is] desolate, without man and without beast" -in the cities of Judah, in the streets of Jerusalem that are desolate, without man and without inhabitant and without beast,

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:11
segments: 'the voice of joy and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the voice of those who will say: "Praise the LORD of hosts, For the LORD [is]  good, For His mercy [endures] forever" -[and] of those [who will] bring the sacrifice of praise into the house of the LORD. For I will cause the captives of the land to return as at the first,' says the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:12
segments: "Thus says the LORD of hosts: 'In this place which is desolate, without man and without beast, and in all its cities, there shall again be a dwelling place of shepherds causing [their] flocks to lie down.

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:13
segments: 'In the cities of the mountains, in the cities of the lowland, in the cities of the South, in the land of Benjamin, in the places around Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, the flocks shall again pass under the hands of him who counts [them],' says the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:14
segments: 'Behold, the days are coming,' says the LORD, 'that I will perform that good thing which I have promised to the house of Israel and to the house of Judah:

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:15
segments: 'In those days and at that time I will cause to grow up to David A Branch of righteousness; He shall execute judgment and righteousness in the earth.

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:16
segments: In those days Judah will be saved, And Jerusalem will dwell safely. And this [is the name] by which she will be called: THE LORD OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS.'

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:17
segments: ¶"For thus says the LORD: 'David shall never lack a man to sit on the throne of the house of Israel;

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:18
segments: 'nor shall the priests, the Levites, lack a man to offer burnt offerings before Me, to kindle grain offerings, and to sacrifice continually.'"

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:19
segments: And the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, saying,

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:20
segments: "Thus says the LORD: 'If you can break My covenant with the day and My covenant with the night, so that there will not be day and night in their season,

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:21
segments: 'then My covenant may also be broken with David My servant, so that he shall not have a son to reign on his throne, and with the Levites, the priests, My ministers.

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:22
segments: 'As the host of heaven cannot be numbered, nor the sand of the sea measured, so will I multiply the descendants of David My servant and the Levites who minister to Me.'"

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:23
segments: Moreover the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, saying,

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:24
segments: "Have you not considered what these people have spoken, saying, 'The two families which the LORD has chosen, He has also cast them off'? Thus they have despised My people, as if they should no more be a nation before them.

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:25
segments: "Thus says the LORD: 'If My covenant [is] not with day and night, [and if] I have not appointed the ordinances of heaven and earth,

entries.title: Jeremiah 33:26
segments: 'then I will cast away the descendants of Jacob and David My servant, [so] that I will not take [any] of his descendants [to be] rulers over the descendants of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. For I will cause their captives to return, and will have mercy on them.'"
